phases.name: v6dev_in_rn50
phases.cmd: source configs/ws/env.sh && ulimit -n $(ulimit -Hn) && uv run tracecal extract-camera-dev in_rn50 --batch-size 128 --workers 8 && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= uv run python scripts/explore_v6.py in_rn50
